options.why: Found $x^2=0.64$ but chose the positive root; in the second quadrant $x<0$.

questions.solution_text:
On the unit circle $x^2+y^2=1$, with $x=\cos\theta$ and $y=\sin\theta$.
$\cos^2\theta=1-\sin^2\theta$
$=1-0.6^2$
$=0.64$
$\cos\theta=\pm0.8$
In the second quadrant $x<0$, so $\cos\theta=-0.8$.
